about.seo_desc: Learn more about TechDeal blog, our gaming and tech news sections, and subscribe to our deals newsletter.
about.heading: About TechDeal
about.para1: TechDeal is a technology news and knowledge-sharing site founded in 2026, focusing on the most practical topics for users: OS tips, app reviews, hardware news, the gaming world, and great tech deals updated daily.
about.para2: With an editorial team experienced in technology and digital media, we are committed to delivering accurate, verified, and genuinely useful content — not just clickbait. Every article on TechDeal is written from real-world experience and an independent user perspective.
about.pillar_tech_desc: Practical guides, Windows/iOS/Android OS tips, hardware analysis, and app reviews from an everyday user perspective.
about.pillar_game_desc: Curated list of free games and apps on Steam, Epic Games, App Store, and Google Play — updated fastest, selected with care.
about.value1_desc: Editorial content is fully independent, not influenced by advertisers or commercial partners.
about.value2_desc: Our team verifies information before publishing, especially for time-limited free deals, so you never waste your time.
about.value3_desc: We say no to junk links, ad-filled URL shorteners, or malware. All download and shopping links are carefully vetted to protect your experience.
about.newsletter_desc: Don't miss free game giveaways and carefully selected tech deals. Subscribe to receive our weekly highlights directly in your inbox.
about.privacy_note: We respect your privacy and promise no spam. Unsubscribe anytime.
about.subscribe_success: 🎉 Subscribed successfully! Stay tuned for amazing deals!

contact.seo_desc: Contact TechDeal. Submit feedback, report article errors, or explore advertising partnership opportunities here.
contact.heading: Contact
contact.subheading: Have a question, feedback, or want to collaborate? We're always ready to listen. Reach us via the form below or directly through our contact info — typically responding within 24 business hours.
contact.reason1_desc: If you find incorrect information, broken links, or apps that are no longer free but haven't been updated yet, let us know so we can fix it right away.
contact.reason2_desc: TechDeal welcomes collaboration opportunities with tech brands, app developers, and media partners. Please email us with the subject "Commercial Partnership" for priority response.
contact.reason3_desc: Are you a tech enthusiast who wants to contribute articles to TechDeal? We always welcome contributors with practical knowledge and an independent perspective.

contact.success_desc: Thank you for reaching out. We have received your message and will respond as soon as possible.
